scope: Investigate the one 1.64 paid acceptance's quality omissions and unused optional consumption entry; fix confirmed BGS gaps without changing role/Review prompts, native code, formal frontend or real game.

paidEvidence.actualScope: Author told verification to rebuild, rerun existing suites, follow par/crash-window/HUD-font to source, and inspect L1/crash screenshots. The opening mentioned eight domains, but the actionable list only traced three facts. Author imposed 500 Chinese characters, not BGS.
paidEvidence.sourceReading: No new design-body read in this turn; review-sources without --details returned source identities/sections, not prose. Earlier history may contain the bodies; lack of a new read does not prove they were never read. Unchanged bytes cannot prove an old semantic judgment correct.
paidEvidence.unusedEntry: No main/child measure --help or --consumption-json call; actual record contains build/runtime-smoke only. Generated adapter and host dispatch were present. No observed lost argument, unavailable bridge or failed consumption invocation.
paidEvidence.nativeVerification: Read-only inspection of builtin-tools/AgentTool/built-in/verificationAgent.ts confirms a general implementation verifier: build/tests mandatory, command-backed PASS/FAIL, project writes prohibited. It already warns that passing author tests is not independent proof. This round still repeated author-selected checks and wrote build/test outputs via Bash. Native template/execution is not modified or rewrapped here.
paidEvidence.hostVerdict: BGS retained quality=unverified and deliveryEligible=false; it did not parse model PASS into game acceptance.
paidEvidence.causalLimits: There is no controlled comparison proving long context alone caused this miss. No consumption attempt was made, so full-registry prerequisites are a confirmed usability obstacle, not a proven sole cause of this round's omission.

findings.class: Agent task/evidence selection plus LLM judgment
findings.root: All-domain acceptance was narrowed into proving the author's selected facts. The verifier repeated the same assertion/screenshot selection, so independence of execution did not produce independent coverage.
findings.action: No additional Reviewer, prompt or forced delegation. Keep host observations/coverage separate from report semantics and model verdicts. Audio promise consistency, numerical optimality and subjective quality remain unverified.

findings.class: BGS tool discoverability and result-scope gap
findings.root: Consumption option/support were only in measure help; the frequently used handoff and compact receipt exposed performed checks but not available/unmeasured checks or full actual coverage.
findings.action: Existing handoff/inspect now return available checks, option, supported/excluded technologies and unmeasured checks. Existing help has a valid JSON example. Compact check results retain actual coverage. Automatic startup context and role prompt remain unchanged; selecting or reading these facts is still Agent behavior.

findings.root: Pixel driver needs bound static image/Tilemap resources, font driver a bound custom DOM font, audio driver encoded HTML audio. Maglev uses procedural Canvas/system fonts/WebAudio, so these three drivers cannot prove its promises.
findings.action: Expose actual exclusions; do not force irrelevant probes, fabricate resources, suppress unsupported findings or claim all consumption/quality has passed.

findings.class: Confirmed BGS deterministic UI checker gap
findings.root: Outer node size/position matched while runtime-inserted child text escaped its rectangle. Static JSON allocation and star count cannot detect this content overflow.
findings.action: Existing UI driver now observes visible DOM text fragments on selected authored text/button nodes before/change/restoration. Escaping text fails; hidden text and valid wrapping pass; clipping/pseudo-content is unverified. No symbol/game-specific rule; no new stage.

findings.root: Reusing old prepareUiProbes unconditionally required every registered screen/viewport, inconsistent with a directed autonomous diagnostic. A six-screen Canvas game cannot reach all screens by the simple DOM-click probe path.
findings.action: One explicit internal UI scope option makes autonomous measurements selected-node/state probes with unobserved screens/viewports recorded. Existing Task full-registry preconditions are preserved. Selected PASS is not whole-game PASS.

files: workflow-v3/pixel-consumption.ts (type-only separation of UI text-fit flag)
changes.checkerVersion: v3-ui-dom-consumption.2; old outer-box-only UI receipts are obsolete, not silently upgraded
changes.whyNotSimpler: More prompt text cannot mechanically measure dynamic DOM overflow. Globally deleting the old registry prerequisite would change unrelated Task contracts; a single scoped argument reuses the driver without another pipeline. Availability and coverage reuse existing handoff/receipt, not a new framework.
unchanged: Native history, delegation tool input/results and model configuration

failedAsExpected: Partial screen/viewport refused by inherited registry mode
Visible dynamic two-row overflow incorrectly passed

additionalReproduction.failedAsExpected: Nested pseudo-content incorrectly counted as complete text-fit; corrected to unverified

dynamicOverflowReceipt.proof: Correct outer geometry, passed build/smoke, actual overflow retained as failed consumption in handoff; export refuses this failed requested-check receipt; source bytes unchanged

regression.counting: Final affected/core plus new overflow receipt and native transport: 94 distinct passing cases. Earlier 110-case seven-file driver compatibility run overlaps these and is not added; its unchanged pixel/font/audio branches also passed.
initialRepairFailures: Required new UI-only property unintentionally entered the pixel type via Omit; exclude it type-only, not change pixel runtime semantics
Readonly tuple comparison assertions fixed without changing production array contracts

Full availability metadata inflated startup context to 3249 characters, then a tiny flag still reached 2627; remove it entirely from startup, keep facts in explicit handoff/inspect; existing 2600 regression gate not increased

integrity.hashMethod: Existing public nonhidden-file audit excluding node_modules/transcripts; not all hidden bytes

limitations: Offline tests prove BGS availability/scope/result transport and generic selected-DOM overflow detection, not that a real Agent adopts the probes or covers all screens.
Canvas gameplay paths, unseen states, sibling occlusion, actual glyph ink/shadows, aesthetics, WebAudio concurrency/listening and prose numerical proofs remain outside this deterministic check.
Maglev original findings remain untouched; semantic omissions and old long-history cost are not claimed resolved. No automatic paid experiment, source repair or delivery PASS.
